draft.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single full-room concept illustration for the Russian cozy grocery game "Лавка у моря", for reviewing furniture geometry before implementation. Landscape, approximately 3:2.
Input image 1 is a reference for the existing room's architecture, seaside view, sunlight, materials and palette. Input image 2 is a furniture and game-art style reference, NOT a target to preserve its failed layout. Omit ALL interface, title banners, buttons, counters, icons, HUD, and UI panels.

Primary request: replace the two badly mismatched display units with TWO IDENTICAL MIRROR-SYMMETRIC full-height grocery display cabinets, compactly arranged as a true 90-DEGREE L in a room corner. Their inner short ends meet neatly at the rear corner; one cabinet follows the left wall and the other follows the right wall. The viewer looks directly along the bisector of that corner. In this camera, the left cabinet recedes to the upper right and the right cabinet recedes to the upper left, an equal and opposite 45-degree turn from the viewer's horizontal axis. Show the broad FRONT of both cabinets and their shelf top surfaces clearly. The mirrored geometry and matching shelf heights must be unmistakable, with a continuous right-angle elbow. These are two physically separate identical cabinets, not a straight front-facing double bookcase, not two parallel units, not a diagonal single cabinet, not a V of disconnected units. Correct 3D perspective and contact with the floor are essential.

Furniture: both units use the SAME design, SAME width, SAME substantial height, SAME depth, SAME thick turquoise curved side supports and honey-oak shelves, in mirrored perspective. Each unit has two generous upper display tiers and a deep wicker storage bay below, with a solid raised plinth and visible upright structural supports. They look like sturdy waist/chest-high shop furniture, roughly 100–115 cm high. Neither is a floor-level tray, a flat plank or a squat shoe rack. Each front is about twice as wide as high, not a long low bench. Matching horizontal shelf tiers join visually at equal elevations. Small orderly groups of milk bottles, jam and honey jars on upper shelves; fruit and bread in wicker trays in middle shelves. No dense clutter.

Composition: make the paired L-shaped displays the visual focus in the back corner of a cozy small room. Use a centered corner camera so the two walls recede symmetrically; the left wall contains the turquoise-framed sea-view window and the open entrance farther left. Keep the window bright and the whole doorway and entry aisle completely unobstructed. Warm pale plaster, turquoise skirting and wooden floor, wooden ceiling beams, sunny Mediterranean seaside view, as in the references. The two cabinets occupy the corner neatly without a big empty gap, shelving under the left window stands properly upright. A compact matching turquoise cashier counter with rounded honey-oak top and brass cash register sits on the foreground right, leaving the corner joint and both cabinet fronts visible and leaving a generous clear aisle from the left entrance. Camera wide enough to show the entire two cabinets and their floor contact. No third shelf unit, no random extra furniture. Plain teal shop sign on the right wall, without lettering.
Style: match the reference's polished tactile casual-game raster illustration: warmly lit honey oak, rich maritime turquoise, cream plaster, soft rounded edges, accurate depth, detailed but clean. No people, no labels, no angle diagrams, no text, no watermark.
This is ONLY a proposal image; do not produce UI or a sprite atlas.
draft.review: Cabinets look too nearly parallel; corner perspective insufficiently clear.

references.role: edit target for stronger mirrored corner geometry

proposal.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: second proposal illustration, not an implementation.

The reference is a FIRST DRAFT that FAILED THE GEOMETRY: the displays look almost straight and parallel. Correct that failure decisively. Keep the warm turquoise and oak seaside grocery game art style and identical matching display cabinet design, but freely reframe and reconstruct the room and perspective. Do not preserve the first draft's nearly flat back wall or low-angle front-on camera.

MANDATORY GEOMETRY: two mirror-identical cabinets form a real square 90-degree room corner. Camera faces the corner bisector from a noticeably elevated 30-degree viewpoint, using a symmetric isometric-like three-quarter room view. Both long cabinet faces recede at pronounced equal and opposite diagonals toward a shared center-back inner junction. The LEFT cabinet's long shelf edges travel diagonally UP-RIGHT toward the junction; the RIGHT cabinet's long shelf edges travel diagonally UP-LEFT toward that SAME junction. In the picture these diagonals should be approximately 25–30 degrees from horizontal, definitely not nearly horizontal. The two long axes are 90 degrees apart IN REAL SPACE, with each cabinet rotated symmetrically 45 degrees relative to the camera direction. Both outer ends are clearly CLOSER to camera; the shared inner end is deepest in the corner. We see the fronts of BOTH wings and the shelf tops, with convincing visible depth. No straight row of two cabinets. No front-on cabinet. No straight back wall. No fisheye. Room walls and floor plank lines agree with the same corner geometry.

Use exactly two separate identical sturdy upright grocery display cabinets, each about twice as wide as high, two display shelves over deep wicker storage, turquoise curved side supports and solid raised base. Same heights and dimensions, mirror views. Neither is flat or on the ground. Whole silhouettes and feet visible. Match tiny groups of milk bottles, jam/honey jars, fruit baskets and bread in the references, clean and uncluttered. The two INNER short ends meet snugly at the corner; no awkward large gap, no third connecting cabinet.

Frame the complete L-shaped paired furniture prominently in a cozy seaside shop corner with both walls angled clearly in perspective. Window on the left wall ABOVE the left cabinet, sea visible, left entrance and walkway clear. Pale warm plaster, turquoise window frames and skirting, honey oak floor and beams, soft sunny light. A SMALL matching cashier counter in lower-right foreground with brass register may appear but must be completely visible inside the image, not crop out of frame or obscure either display. Keep clear generous central floor. The cabinets are the focus; architecture supports the geometry. No extra furniture, no people, no text, no signs with text, no UI, no badges, no diagram arrows.
Polished tactile Mediterranean casual game illustration. Landscape 3:2. This is ONLY a composition proposal image.
proposal.review: Matching height, two mirrored visible cabinet fronts, clear corner junction; concept camera differs from the current runtime camera.

constraints: No application or runtime assets modified. Goods painted into the concept are illustrative only; production goods remain independent layers.
